text: Doubled letters could be fillers, nulls added to break up the text. Striking them out would then reveal a simpler cipher underneath.
Three of the six doublets, QQ, SS and TT, fall inside EASTNORTHEAST and BERLINCLOCK, where each half carries a different known letter. They are real letters, not fillers.
The other three, BB, SS and ZZ, were struck in all seven combinations and tested with repeating keys, ciphertext autokey and both: nothing changes beyond the shuffled rate.
